Genesis engine source: https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/genesis-world
Pinned upstream commit: 7cd75da686864bb229efebf19d9c689ce198ea57
License: Apache-2.0; see GENESIS-LICENSE.

genesis-mpm.patch preserves the engine changes in the calibrated local engine,
including per-material MPM reference volume and the existing optional phase-field
and NACC extensions (these optional models are not enabled by the butter demo).
It is applied to the public upstream commit, not to a private or sibling clone.
The archive, patch and patched files are checked against genesis-lock.json.

physics/cream_materials.py and physics/cream_contact.py were moved verbatim from
the calibrated cream example at local source commit
9a4ab7a3820781df7aea39fd0376e4acc07a3c4f plus its working contact corrections.
All required custom source is now part of this repository. The JSON bread
defaults preserve that example's calibration for the regression test.

CD-MPM bread source and its MIT license are in assets/reference/cdmpm/.
Isaac Sim is installed separately under NVIDIA's license, not redistributed here.
